message.content: wait how do I add capture-harness to system audio recording settings pane?

questions.question: Which of the remaining scenarios can you drive right now? I'll script everything around whatever you pick.

options.label: Voice fixtures (near-end + double-talk)
options.description: You speak for ~15s each while I record. Gets 2 of the 3 AEC scenarios on built-in hardware. Takes about 2 minutes total.

options.label: USB microphone
options.description: Plug in a USB mic. Unlocks the USB half of the fixture matrix plus the definitive microphone-disconnect test (unplug mid-capture).

options.label: Screen lock + sleep/wake
options.description: Disruptive: I start a capture, you lock the screen / sleep the Mac, wait ~30s, come back. The plan requires screen-lock behaviour to be measured.

options.label: Real meeting audio (Zoom or Meet)
options.description: Join a Zoom test meeting or a Meet call so I can probe a real WebRTC meeting app rather than tab playback.

questions.question: Teams isn't installed (only its loopback audio driver remains). How should I handle that row of the matrix?

options.label: Record it as untestable (Recommended)
options.description: Document that Teams was not installed, and that Teams-in-a-browser is already covered by the Chrome and Safari results. No install.

options.label: I'll install Teams
options.description: You install the desktop app and I probe it like Zoom. Adds a real Electron/Chromium desktop app to the matrix.
